responsibility: Implements s390x ABI classification for returns and arguments, including Linux-specific non-ignored ZST handling, vector and single-float special cases, 64-bit scalar extension, and indirect lowering for unsupported aggregate sizes and forms.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/s390x.rs`, this file handles s390x function-call ABI decisions such as vector/single-float special cases, 64-bit scalar extension, Linux ZST handling, and indirect lowering, not inline-assembly register definitions.
